node.statement: Apply the registered external lem-stage1-polar-retraction with the constants fixed in node 1.1. Its guard is the first root guard and node 1.2 gives t>0; its inner inclusion calU_t subseteq S_delta and node 1.7 therefore put U bold-dot V and U^dagger in S_delta. Hence the inverse component u_delta:S_delta->calU is defined at both points. Their right inverses were constructed in nodes 1.5 and 1.6. Since the algebra, delta, U, and V were arbitrary, the witnesses C_grp=4 together with C_pol,kappa_pol prove the root contract.
